item.title: COLLEGE BASKETBALL: Pirate men stay alive in playoff chase
item.description: Peninsula Daily News Peninsula Daily News - Your #1 News Source for the Olympic Peninsula, Port Angeles, Sequim, Port Townsend and beyond.
